name: ui-decomposers
description: Two crossing-axis 'decomposer' skills for visual artifacts: ui-layout-decomposer (read, grade, and design any UI layout on the OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT axes, with a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library) and ui-mermaid-decomposer (create, decompose, and grade advanced Mermaid diagrams on the INTENT x RENDER axes, backed by a verbatim syntax catalog for the 11 advanced types, a gated M1-M6 rubric, and a mechanized render-check). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
